feature_discrepancy_findings.title: React 170-record payment-head catalogue is not an identity-preserving migration
feature_discrepancy_findings.source_evidence: v11: const NBR_LAW_MASTER, line 4097; id 1=16A Surcharge, id 5=19AAAAA undisclosed investment, id 125=74 Tax with return
feature_discrepancy_findings.react_evidence: main: src/data/paymentHeads.ts; ID 1 was generated as Tax with Return — Individual Taxpayers; ID 5 as Special Retrospective Revision Surcharge; makeCode() constructs unproven economic codes
feature_discrepancy_findings.remediation: Keep original master bytes/identities intact, replace synthetic catalogue in a review branch only after a full 170-ID exact source comparison; no invented economic code reaches financial execution.

feature_discrepancy_findings.title: v11 multi-item and multi-taxpayer cart differs from React single-line-item receipt path
feature_discrepancy_findings.source_evidence: v11: cart flows line 3966+, 4870–4968; multi-item review and consent revalidation
feature_discrepancy_findings.react_evidence: main: src/components/screens/GuestPayment.tsx and PaymentWizard.tsx each constructs one PaymentLineItem and one ChallanReceipt per confirmation
feature_discrepancy_findings.remediation: Preserve batch/cart contract with unique item identity, taxpayer, category, head, AY, payer and amount; gate payment on all items and re-verify mandates.

feature_discrepancy_findings.title: Original taxpayer-side mandate, scoped consent and OTP journey not established in migrated flow
feature_discrepancy_findings.source_evidence: v11 lines 4534–4619, 4713–4778, 4945–4963; session/OTP demo, not real identity integration
feature_discrepancy_findings.react_evidence: main: GuestPayment.tsx collects representativeTin and representativeName; these strings do not establish authorization
feature_discrepancy_findings.remediation: Implement backend-verifiable role/mandate contract after approved identity and taxpayer consent policy; do not treat a typed representative TIN as authority.

feature_discrepancy_findings.title: Simulated instant Treasury-scrolled receipts remain distinct from actual settlement and entitlement
feature_discrepancy_findings.react_evidence: main: GuestPayment.tsx and PaymentWizard.tsx build demo receipt treasuryStatus=TREASURY_SCROLLED after setTimeout; recent fail-closed fix keeps taxCreditStatus pending
feature_discrepancy_findings.remediation: Keep demo labels on all events; future settlement and credit posting require independent verified evidence and idempotent state machines.

feature_discrepancy_findings.title: v11 audit hash is demonstrative non-cryptographic and browser-state only
feature_discrepancy_findings.source_evidence: v11 lines 2333–2347; simple 32-bit FNV-like hash in JavaScript, not immutable server storage
feature_discrepancy_findings.react_evidence: main AuditTrail.tsx has been relabelled as demo action log; no independent durable cryptographic proof
feature_discrepancy_findings.remediation: Before real audit use server append-only storage, authorization, complete canonical hashing, durable readback, tamper tests.

feature_discrepancy_findings.title: Guidance and estimator contain hardcoded unverified financial figures
feature_discrepancy_findings.source_evidence: v11: advance tax example data 2277–2280, travel-tax table 4415+, legal open questions 1989–2016
feature_discrepancy_findings.react_evidence: main GuidanceAssistant.tsx includes illustrative thresholds/slabs, 5,000 minimum and rebate percentage, not sourced to active taxpayer-specific controlling law
feature_discrepancy_findings.remediation: Keep illustrative display visibly non-authoritative or disable executable calculated entitlement until provenance, year/event and legal applicability are validated.

feature_discrepancy_findings.title: Original 5,481-line HTML is referenced but not preserved byte-identically in current GitHub repository
feature_discrepancy_findings.react_evidence: main reference/README.md records the original hash; the full original source file is not in the inspected GitHub tree
feature_discrepancy_findings.remediation: Add controlled original unchanged to dedicated reference location only with approved repository storage policy; verify SHA and test exact 29 renderer names.

feature_discrepancy_findings.title: Direct renderers versus navigation aliases must be counted separately
feature_discrepancy_findings.source_evidence: v11 contains 29 PAGES.* assignments; guestwh calls startGuestWH -> guestpay; facilitate calls startPay(null) -> pay
feature_discrepancy_findings.react_evidence: The 29 direct source renderers are confirmed; two additional navigation actions reuse existing renderers and must not be counted as independent screens
feature_discrepancy_findings.remediation: Use 29 v11 page renderer parity tests plus two aliases/flows separately; verify route to screen mapping.

feature_discrepancy_findings.title: Guest withholding deposit and later eTDS deductee allocation require separate release gates
feature_discrepancy_findings.source_evidence: v11 lines 4380–4411, 2691–2713; guest deposits unallocated until deductee evidence applied
feature_discrepancy_findings.react_evidence: Current React screens capture deducteeTin and a demo withholding receipt but do not prove the complete original eTDS allocation state machine or official eTDS
feature_discrepancy_findings.remediation: Preserve agent register versus deductee ledger; verify dedupe, allocation sum, ownership, year, authorization before posting credits.

feature_discrepancy_findings.title: Officer demo role switching is not authenticated server-side maker/reviewer/approver authorization
feature_discrepancy_findings.source_evidence: v11 lines 2998–3059 and 5084–5108; fake SSO, role selector and in-memory data
feature_discrepancy_findings.react_evidence: Current React CorrectionQueue.tsx obtains mutable userRole from client state; server policy not proven
feature_discrepancy_findings.remediation: Keep demo segregated; authorize each transition with role, distinct principal, jurisdiction, source authority and durable audit.

source_record.verbatim_prototype_rule: A PaymentTransaction MUST NOT reach FinancialReceiptStatus=RECEIVED before its ACSReference exists, and MUST NOT reach a CREDIT_OK TaxCreditStatus before FinancialReceiptStatus=RECEIVED.

blocker.detail: Prototype semantic crosswalk is expressly draft/not-law/not-certified; mapping and legal validation are unverified.

source_record.verbatim_prototype_rule: A ConsentRequest for a TIN with no matching Taxpayer record MUST fail and MUST NOT create a new Taxpayer, Authorization, or any other record.

blocker.detail: Prototype semantic crosswalk is expressly draft/not-law/not-certified; mapping and legal validation are unverified.

source_record.verbatim_prototype_rule: A ConsentDecision's decidedBy MUST equal the Authorization's granter and MUST come from a session structurally distinct from the grantee's — a Representative can never be the actor of a decision on their own pending Authorization.

blocker.detail: Prototype semantic crosswalk is expressly draft/not-law/not-certified; mapping and legal validation are unverified.

source_record.verbatim_prototype_rule: A CorrectionRequest's approval MUST create a new TaxEvent (Reposting) and MUST NOT mutate the TaxEvent referenced by the original credit.

blocker.detail: Prototype semantic crosswalk is expressly draft/not-law/not-certified; mapping and legal validation are unverified.

source_record.verbatim_prototype_rule: A MakerReviewerApproverDecision chain for one CorrectionRequest or offline TaxEvent MUST NOT contain the same Officer twice.

blocker.detail: Prototype semantic crosswalk is expressly draft/not-law/not-certified; mapping and legal validation are unverified.

source_record.verbatim_prototype_rule: An OTPChallenge MUST be rejected once its Expiry has passed or its AttemptCount has reached MaxAttempts, and MUST be cleared (never left reusable) immediately after a successful verification.

blocker.detail: Prototype semantic crosswalk is expressly draft/not-law/not-certified; mapping and legal validation are unverified.

source_record.verbatim_prototype_rule: A date-only Authorization Expiry MUST be interpreted as 23:59:59 Bangladesh time (UTC+6) on the given date, not 00:00:00 UTC.

blocker.detail: Prototype semantic crosswalk is expressly draft/not-law/not-certified; mapping and legal validation are unverified.

source_record.verbatim_prototype_rule: If any cart item's Authorization becomes invalid (missing, pending, expired, suspended, revoked, denied, or out of scope) after entering review, the WHOLE submission MUST stop — no partial submission — and the payer MUST explicitly reconfirm the revised cart before any resubmission.

blocker.detail: Prototype semantic crosswalk is expressly draft/not-law/not-certified; mapping and legal validation are unverified.

source_record.verbatim_prototype_rule: An IdentityMisuseReport MUST NOT cause any disclosure of whether a claimed TIN exists, a taxpayer's name, or any account data to an unverified Complainant.

blocker.detail: Prototype semantic crosswalk is expressly draft/not-law/not-certified; mapping and legal validation are unverified.

source_record.verbatim_prototype_rule: No ContainmentAction may reference or act on any Authorization or PaymentTransaction until concernsAffectedTaxpayer is populated (i.e. the Complainant is verified, by OTP or authorized manual/out-of-band confirmation).

blocker.detail: Prototype semantic crosswalk is expressly draft/not-law/not-certified; mapping and legal validation are unverified.

source_record.verbatim_prototype_rule: A ContainmentAction of type PAYMENT_ATTRIBUTION_DISPUTED MUST NOT alter FinancialReceiptStatus, TreasurySettlement, or the recorded Amount of the disputed PaymentTransaction — only a subsequent, separately approved CorrectionRequest may change tax attribution.

blocker.detail: Prototype semantic crosswalk is expressly draft/not-law/not-certified; mapping and legal validation are unverified.

source_record.verbatim_prototype_rule: A ContainmentAction of type MANDATE_SUSPENDED MUST NOT delete the Authorization record; its prior ACTIVE history remains inspectable.

blocker.detail: Prototype semantic crosswalk is expressly draft/not-law/not-certified; mapping and legal validation are unverified.

source_record.verbatim_prototype_rule: Revealing a masked NID (NID_REVEALED) MUST always produce a corresponding AuditEvent in the same transaction as the reveal.

blocker.detail: Prototype semantic crosswalk is expressly draft/not-law/not-certified; mapping and legal validation are unverified.

source_record.verbatim_prototype_rule: A tax credit whose PaymentTransaction is BLOCKED under a CorrectionRequest MUST NOT reduce any derived figure (outstanding balance, settled amount, recommendation, certificate) until the correction is decided; it is reported separately as blocked.

blocker.detail: Prototype semantic crosswalk is expressly draft/not-law/not-certified; mapping and legal validation are unverified.

source_record.verbatim_prototype_rule: Claim usage MUST follow the receipt lineage (the original TaxEvent and every TaxEvent that supersedes it). A credit already claimed in a filed return MUST NOT be corrected through the payment-correction workflow except together with an amendment of that return.

blocker.detail: Prototype semantic crosswalk is expressly draft/not-law/not-certified; mapping and legal validation are unverified.

source_record.verbatim_prototype_rule: A PaymentTransaction lifecycle transition MUST be accepted only from its defined predecessor status; a repeated or out-of-order settlement signal MUST NOT post a second tax credit.

blocker.detail: Prototype semantic crosswalk is expressly draft/not-law/not-certified; mapping and legal validation are unverified.

source_record.verbatim_prototype_rule: Only CREDITED advance tax counts toward an advance-tax schedule. Payments and challans still in progress are reported as pending, never as paid, and balance-based options MUST disclose money already in progress.

blocker.detail: Prototype semantic crosswalk is expressly draft/not-law/not-certified; mapping and legal validation are unverified.

source_record.verbatim_prototype_rule: A PAYMENT_CONFIRM OTP MUST be bound to the exact batch (taxpayer, category, assessment year and amount of every item, plus channel and method); any change invalidates it and nothing is submitted.

blocker.detail: Prototype semantic crosswalk is expressly draft/not-law/not-certified; mapping and legal validation are unverified.

source_record.verbatim_prototype_rule: OTP resends and failed attempts MUST be budgeted per session and purpose; issuing a new challenge MUST NOT reset the failure count.

blocker.detail: Prototype semantic crosswalk is expressly draft/not-law/not-certified; mapping and legal validation are unverified.

source_record.verbatim_prototype_rule: A credit-eligibility check MUST resolve a reference only within the requesting taxpayer's own account before disclosing any status, lineage or amount.

blocker.detail: Prototype semantic crosswalk is expressly draft/not-law/not-certified; mapping and legal validation are unverified.

source_record.verbatim_prototype_rule: A CorrectionRequest MUST NOT be submitted or approved when the requester's authority does not cover both the original and the requested attribution, when the requested attribution equals the current one, or when the credit is already claimed in a filed return.

blocker.detail: Prototype semantic crosswalk is expressly draft/not-law/not-certified; mapping and legal validation are unverified.

source_record.verbatim_prototype_rule: An order-based reduction or waiver of tax, penalty or interest MUST be recorded as LIABILITY_REDUCED against the relevant liability, never as a tax credit, payment or 'tax paid'.

blocker.detail: Prototype semantic crosswalk is expressly draft/not-law/not-certified; mapping and legal validation are unverified.

source_record.verbatim_prototype_rule: An AuditEvent hash MUST cover every field of the record, so that a silent edit to any field breaks the chain.

blocker.detail: Prototype semantic crosswalk is expressly draft/not-law/not-certified; mapping and legal validation are unverified.

source_record.verbatim_prototype_rule: An OTC challan not paid within its validity MUST move to FinancialReceiptStatus=EXPIRED and stop counting as pending.

blocker.detail: Prototype semantic crosswalk is expressly draft/not-law/not-certified; mapping and legal validation are unverified.

source_record.verbatim_prototype_rule: A receipt or certificate MUST record the figures and statuses as at issue; a reprint shows the issued snapshot and, where different, the current status labelled as current.

blocker.detail: Prototype semantic crosswalk is expressly draft/not-law/not-certified; mapping and legal validation are unverified.

source_record.verbatim_prototype_rule: A DisputedPaymentAttribution MUST be shown to the affected taxpayer and MUST stop the credit being newly claimed until the review ends; it still never alters the FinancialReceipt.

blocker.detail: Prototype semantic crosswalk is expressly draft/not-law/not-certified; mapping and legal validation are unverified.

source_record.verbatim_prototype_rule: A signed-in taxpayer paying their own tax needs no additional identity step. blocker.detail: Prototype semantic crosswalk is expressly draft/not-law/not-certified; mapping and legal validation are unverified.

source_record.verbatim_prototype_rule: The payment purpose (tp:PaymentPurposeType) MUST be chosen before the taxpayer. 'My tax liability' and 'another taxpayer's liability' are the same TAX_LIABILITY_PAYMENT, distinguished only by whether payerTin equals taxpayerTin.

source_record.verbatim_prototype_rule: A PaymentTransaction MUST keep payerTin and taxpayerTin (or, for withholding, withholdingAgentTin and deductees) as recorded at creation; the taxpayer is never inferred from the payer.

source_record.verbatim_prototype_rule: A tax credit from a TAX_LIABILITY_PAYMENT is posted only to the taxpayer's ledger. A payer who is not the taxpayer receives no tax credit; the payment appears in the payer's payment history only.

blocker.detail: Prototype semantic crosswalk is expressly draft/not-law/not-certified; mapping and legal validation are unverified.

source_record.verbatim_prototype_rule: A WITHHOLDING_TAX_DEPOSIT has a withholding agent (payer) and one or more deductees, each linked to an eTDS record; its amount equals the sum of those records. source_record.verbatim_prototype_rule: A source-tax category MUST NOT be accepted in a TAX_LIABILITY_PAYMENT journey, and a liability category MUST NOT be accepted in a WITHHOLDING_TAX_DEPOSIT journey.

blocker.detail: Prototype semantic crosswalk is expressly draft/not-law/not-certified; mapping and legal validation are unverified.

source_record.verbatim_prototype_rule: An 'Other Tax Payment' MUST resolve, through an NBR notice, order, intimation or return reference, to a defined payment category before any ACS call; it is never submitted to ACS as 'other'.

source_record.scenario: Synthetic role E2E > unit/security/visual checks > CI build > readback audit > staged publish > rollback rehearsal
source_record.given: Given a controlled synthetic dataset, explicit actor/session role, and isolated mock or approved sandbox dependencies
source_record.when: When each step in the recorded journey runs in its original sequence
source_record.then: One immutable build SHA links tests and deployment; demo release labelled demonstration only
source_record.negative_or_boundary: Missing checks, inconclusive law or failed ledger audit prevents financial activation
source_record.source_locator: v11: payment wizard 4489–5018; taxpayer 3193–3990; public 4230–4488; officers 5019–5268; ontology 1751–1792 (apply only relevant ranges)
source_record.repository_locator: src/App.tsx; src/components/screens; src/services; external adapters only if approved
source_record.release_gates: isolated role-based E2E; financial invariants; backend evidence where relevant; legal source/period approval; separate production authorization
source_record.evidence_required: Executed signed-in/out synthetic journey, expected/observed assertions, network and backend records, audit/ledger readback, test artifact and deployment SHA

status_definitions.NOT STARTED: Work has not started; use only where evidenced.
status_definitions.IN PROGRESS: Work is underway; use only where current evidence supports it.
status_definitions.IMPLEMENTED: Implementation is evidenced but is not thereby tested, live, or accepted.
status_definitions.TESTED: Requirement-specific test evidence is available; it does not alone prove production behavior.
status_definitions.LIVE: Requirement-specific production evidence verifies the applicable behavior.
status_definitions.BLOCKED: A concrete prerequisite, approval, mapping, test, or evidence gap prevents a higher status.
status_definitions.REGRESSED: Previously evidenced behavior has regressed, with a requirement-specific regression reference.
status_definitions.SUPERSEDED: A later approved decision replaces an earlier requirement at the documented scope; preserve the historical source.
